labels: A gauze pad lies over the outer forearm and is held by two separate strips of tape, with a small reddish mark visible on adjacent uncovered skin.; 거즈 패드가 아래팔 바깥면을 덮고 두 테이프 조각으로 고정되며 옆의 드러난 피부에 작은 붉은 자국이 보인다.
definition: Complete optional school-life visual realization: A gauze pad lies over the outer forearm and is held by two separate strips of tape, with a small reddish mark visible on adjacent uncovered skin.
aliases: 붕대와 상처 외관
